chart_review_items.title: Add long-form series and calendar aggregation
chart_review_items.current_state: Line connects values from multiple measure columns and uses numeric axes, not calendar rollups.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Raw orders/events become date-bucketed series without external reshaping.
acceptance_criteria: Date field, interval, metric, and optional categorical series field are first-class.
Day/week/month boundaries and time-zone policy are explicit.
Duplicate timestamps are aggregated in rollup mode; raw-observation mode remains available.
Missing periods have metric-appropriate, explicit zero/gap behavior.
Calendar-aware ticks and brush bounds agree with the source interval.
Series values match an independent grouping of the same source rows.

chart_review_items.title: Add area and stacked-area presentations
chart_review_items.current_state: Line rendering includes paths and points, not filled/stacked area modes.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Time series can show totals and composition through shared grouped data.
acceptance_criteria: Line and area use identical metric results.
Stack ordering, missing buckets, and negative-value behavior are explicit.
Changing mode preserves group identity and filter state.
A rolling window, when added, identifies its size and missing-value policy.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Select dates with explicit calendar semantics
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: UTC daily Calendar views, day/week/month line rollups, period/series selection and date controls now exist.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Relative rolling versus completed periods, quarter/year presets and calendar stepping are not supplied by those additions. Freeze or encode the reference time for any future relative filter.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Keep row, group and window computations semantically distinct
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Scalar formulas and named count/sum/average groups are different controls; calendar rollups add explicit period scope.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Window/rank expressions and arbitrary grouped formula composition are not established. Row sum(x,y) must not be presented as a dataset sum.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Inspect and reuse aggregates with correct denominators
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Pivot contributors and reusable grouped summaries exist; newer stacks/cards/time views expose more aggregate semantics.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Pivot-as-source, subtotal hierarchies, percentages and prior-period calculations are not generally established. New generic charts do not close every pivot outcome.
